direction_check.convention: Spearman(predicted_score, measured_fitness); fitness higher_is_better=true; positive = correct ranking direction
direction_check.note: all per-seed test Spearman values are positive -> predictor ranking direction is correct under the high-score convention

rf_onehot_baseline.consistency_with_plan_reference: plan section 1.1 cites old RF baseline ~ +0.54 after sign conversion; recomputed val=+0.539, test=+0.535 -> consistent

part1_1_position_spearman_correction.definition: per method-round over its 10 best-first recommendations: raw = spearman(position, measured_fitness) (negative = correct); reported = spearman(-position, measured_fitness) (positive = correct)
part1_1_position_spearman_correction.reading_rule: all reported_high_score_correlation values are exact sign-flips of raw; positive magnitude = ranking ability

part1_2_friedman_nemenyi.design: randomized block: block = seed x round (N=9), treatments = 4 methods; per-block values recomputed from recommendations.csv
part1_2_friedman_nemenyi.gate_note: plan section 1.2 sample-size gate requires N(blocks)>=10 for inferential reporting; actual N=9 < 10 (the plan's '36 method-rounds' = 4 methods x 9 blocks of observations, not 36 blocks). Tests reported per plan section 1.2 old-data clause; wording per R2: significance claims require BH-adjusted p<0.05 with effect size and CI.
part1_2_friedman_nemenyi.chi2_approx_note: scipy friedmanchisquare uses the chi-square approximation (as pre-registered); with N=9 the approximation is coarse - flagged.

part1_3_wilcoxon.family: 6 method pairs x 4 metrics = 24 two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests; BH FDR q=0.05 applied across all 24 (primary) and within each metric family of 6 (secondary)
part1_3_wilcoxon.pairing: diff = method_b - method_a within block (same seed x round); n=9 blocks
part1_3_wilcoxon.bootstrap: 95% percentile CI of mean diff; resampling unit = block (seed x round); B=10000; rng seed 20261114
part1_3_wilcoxon.footnote_zero_diffs: zero_method='wilcox': zero differences dropped before ranking; exact mode used when no tied |diffs| and n_eff<25, otherwise normal approximation with continuity correction (footnote per plan 1.3)

proactive_passive.definition: decision point = LLM api_call turn (5 tools offered, tool_choice=auto => >=2 choices); passive = framework-forced action (auto submit after max_score_calls), logged with auto=true

turning_points.definition: score event = predict_fitness tool call; next decision = following tool_call in same round; changed if (tool name changes) OR (same tool and candidate focus-set Jaccard<0.5) OR (explore<->exploit switch). Focus set = mutated (position, residue) pairs of the call's candidate 4-mer list (adaptation: pre-registered strategy_tag fields absent from minimal-schema logs). explore/exploit tag: Jaccard vs union of previous predict calls in the round >=0.5 -> exploit.

part3_autonomy.schema_adaptation_note: agent_log.jsonl uses the minimal schema (kind/round/call_id/tool_name/arguments/result/tokens_used/context_length/model), not the full section-4 schema (no decision_point/choice_space/forced/initiation/strategy_tag fields). Autonomy metrics were therefore derived from the minimal fields as documented per metric; forced actions identified via auto=true on tool_call/submit events.
